title: First-party Rabbi CRM pattern packet
operator_intent_summary: Compile the GHL-like CRM request into first-party BNA CRM requirements without adding external CRM runtime.
raw_source: Make Rabbi's CRM like GHL. It looks sloppy.

decisions_captured.decision: BNA / One Time remains first-party CRM/community. GHL-like means pattern inspiration only.

out_of_scope: No GHL runtime, LeadConnector, GHL env vars, GHL API tools, or external CRM writes.
No email sends, Stripe charges, DNS changes, WhatsApp sends, Telegram sends, Drive writes, Zoom writes, Vimeo writes, or access grants.
No implementation outside the scoped Rabbi provider admin CRM routes.

known_blockers: External CRM runtime is not approved and is not required.

expanded_phrases.GHL-like: Use first-party BNA CRM patterns: list/detail, pipeline, lifecycle stage, activity timeline, communication history, notes, tasks, source/status, and clean detail drawer. Do not add GHL runtime.
expanded_phrases.CRM: Contacts, parents, students, and leads need list/search/filter, lifecycle stage, last activity, source, linked communications, notes, tasks, and class/payment/access status where relevant.
expanded_phrases.pipeline: Business stage board where cards show contact, stage, last activity, source, owner, and next action, with detail opening without losing context.
expanded_phrases.sloppy: Translate subjective defects into VQ findings for IA, layout, actions, data display, responsive behavior, and credibility.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: GHL-like means first-party BNA CRM UX patterns only: list/detail, pipeline board, activity timeline, notes/tasks, and scoped quick actions.

requirements.statement: Compile Rabbi CRM into first-party list/detail and pipeline requirements scoped to One Time.
requirements.expected_result: A Codex-ready CRM packet names routes, data fields, action states, state matrix, screenshots, registry expectations, and no-GHL policy.
acceptance_criteria: CRM expansion includes list/detail, lifecycle stage, pipeline board, activity timeline, notes, tasks, communications, class/access/payment linkage, and scoped data rules.
GHL-like is explicitly interpreted as first-party BNA pattern inspiration with no external CRM runtime.

criteria: Workspace, project, and view class are named.
Before screenshots or exact screenshot blockers are required.
State matrix and action states are complete before code implementation.

loading.aria_semantic_expectation: Main region exposes CRM heading and loading status.
loading.accessibility_expectation: Loading state is announced and does not trap focus.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: CRM loading status appears before populated data.

empty.expected_visible_message: No contacts in this stage yet.
empty.expected_primary_action: Add or import a test-prefixed contact if the execution packet allows test data.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Empty state message is inside the CRM main region.
empty.accessibility_expectation: Primary action has name, role, value, and visible focus.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Empty CRM state distinguishes true empty from loading.

populated.expected_visible_message: Pipeline cards show contact name, stage, last activity, source, owner, and next action.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: Pipeline columns and contact list have navigable labels.
populated.accessibility_expectation: Cards have keyboard path to detail drawer.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: Selected contact opens detail without losing list context.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Apply filters that match no contacts.
filtered_empty.accessibility_expectation: Clear filters button is keyboard reachable.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Clear filters returns populated or empty state.

error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error is associated with CRM region.
error.accessibility_expectation: Error text is readable and not color-only.
error.test_smoke_assertion: CRM API failure renders actionable error state.

blocked_setup.how_to_enter_state: Open a provider-dependent CRM feature without provider setup.
blocked_setup.expected_visible_message: This action is blocked until the named setup is complete.
blocked_setup.aria_semantic_expectation: Blocked status is conveyed in text.
blocked_setup.accessibility_expectation: Blocked card names owner, reason, and next action.
blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: Blocked action cannot perform external writes.

preview_only.how_to_enter_state: Open an import or stage-change preview.

success_readback.how_to_enter_state: Complete an approved local CRM action.
success_readback.accessibility_expectation: Readback appears near the action result.
success_readback.test_smoke_assertion: Success readback includes updated record state.

permission_denied.expected_visible_message: You do not have access to this workspace.
permission_denied.test_smoke_assertion: Wrong-scope user sees no CRM records.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.how_to_enter_state: Select a contact card on mobile.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.expected_visible_message: Selected contact details are visible with a back action.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.aria_semantic_expectation: Detail drawer has label and close/back control.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.accessibility_expectation: Touch targets are at least mobile baseline and focus is not trapped.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile detail state opens and closes without horizontal overflow.

findings.user_impact: Rabbi cannot scan contacts, stage, last activity, and next action efficiently on mobile.
findings.expected_fix: Use list/detail CRM pattern with mobile selected-detail state and clear back action.

accessibility.baseline: WCAG 2.2 A/AA plus BNA mobile touch and reflow requirements.

action_states.label: Sync to GHL
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Forbidden by no-GHL first-party CRM decision.

scope_rules: Rabbi provider admin sees only rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class data.

implementation_batches.scope: One Time CRM product-quality packet generation only
instructions: Generate exact first-party CRM list/detail, pipeline, action, data, state, screenshot, and registry requirements.

tests.expected_result: Compiled packet passes Product Quality Compiler validation.
No unexpanded GHL-like or CRM drift remains.

criteria: Required screenshots exist for all viewports or exact blockers are recorded.
Action and route registry expectations are satisfied.
No GHL runtime or external provider write was added.
App-visible work has deploy and live-smoke proof before Done.

trace.skipped_actions_policy: External provider writes, sends, payments, access grants, DNS, and GHL runtime are skipped unless a future approved packet explicitly authorizes them.

next_packet.description: Verify CRM packet screenshots, state matrix, registry, and no-GHL policy.
